Claire / Diego — joining to run the compliance checklist. Thanks for the early details. Two items from our side before we schedule execution:
1) Scope: we support two actions —
   - Full excision: remove all indexed copies, telemetry events, and application audit entries for the conversation across primary and regional replicas and request removal from short-term backups where feasible. This is irreversible.
   - Scoped redaction: remove sensitive segments from stored transcript and suppress telemetry while preserving non-sensitive metadata for billing and usage metrics.
Please state which you prefer.

2) Authorization: we require either (A) a signed redaction authorization on company letterhead (PDF) from an authorized signatory, or (B) an email from a verified legal mailbox confirming the action and scope. Claire, you mentioned legal is copied — please confirm.

If you confirm full excision and provide the signed PDF, we'll kick off the job. Typical SLA for this one-off is 48–72 business hours for the deletion job to complete; we'll provide a deletion_job_id and compliance attestation once finished.

Attachments: redaction_playbook_v1.2.txt (internal stub — steps/rollback/audit)

Thanks,
